caption:
Google made your review script a liability.

April 2026: Google added two clauses to its Rating Manipulation policy. Staff quotas are banned. So is directing a customer to name a specific tech or rep in their review.

Automated filters catch the pattern: full staff names showing up at unnatural rates, review counts spiking then disappearing, warning banners landing on profiles that never got a human complaint.

The fix is simple. Every customer gets the same request, at the same moment, with no name script and no quota behind it.

See how equal, automated review requests run without you managing a single ask.
DM TRIAL

#GoogleReviews #ReputationManagement #LocalSEO #ServiceBusiness #BlackArrow
rationale: A genuinely new, verified April 2026 Google review-policy change (staff quotas and scripted staff-name mentions now banned) that directly threatens the manual review-ask habits most shops still run, interpreted through the platform's automated, equal-request review engine.
